stages.A: coarse screening on frozen 36-case balanced core; rank by competence-first selection rule
stages.B: top candidates per family on all 200 Development cases
stages.C: targeted refinement only inside the preregistered candidate space followed by all-200 confirmation

candidate_spaces.P2-NATIVE-PID: Cartesian grid over task correction, position/velocity/integral, SO(3) attitude/rate gains, anti-windup limit, and allowed outer rates around the registered nominal rate
candidate_spaces.P2-NATIVE-FULL-LQR: physical-wrench trim linearization with preregistered logarithmic Q/R scale grid and optional integral tracking augmentation
candidate_spaces.P2-NATIVE-TASK-LQR: same audited physical model with output-weighted cutter-tip/tip-velocity/cutter-orientation cost grid
candidate_spaces.P2-SATC-STACK: bounded grid over shock threshold/gain, constraint horizon/weights, conflict coordination, native mapping/inner gains, and allowed registered rates
